title: Guide for the selection and use of piezoelectric ceramic materials and elements
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard deals with the guidance which will help the user to extend the useful and accurate life of the material by ensuring that it is selected and handled correctly during the fabrication stages.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Recommendation of dressing of natural building stones

clause_3_terminology: Guide for the selection and use of piezoelectric ceramic materials and elements

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
